business_problem: Wayfair needed to keep product attributes accurate across a massive catalog and handle large supplier-support volumes without relying on slow, error-prone manual review.
solution_summary: Wayfair combined the OpenAI API and ChatGPT Enterprise to improve catalog quality and supplier operations at scale. For catalog data, the company built an AI system that uses web information and Wayfair's internal definitions to generate labeling guides, then applies OpenAI models to validate and assign product attributes across millions of listings. The workflow is governed by structured audits, supplier validation, and confidence thresholds that determine whether updates can be applied automatically or need additional review. For supplier support, Wayfair embedded OpenAI models into Wilma, its custom support platform, so incoming tickets can be read, enriched with context, routed to the correct team, and in some cases advanced through agentic resolution workflows. Alignment-rate measurements determine when a workflow stays assistive and when it can move toward semi-autonomous autopilot. In parallel, ChatGPT Enterprise seats and ChatGPT Work broadened productivity across the business.

data_flow: Catalog content is combined with web information and Wayfair's internal attribute definitions to create label guides, then OpenAI models validate and update product attributes under confidence-based controls. Supplier tickets flow through Wilma, which adds context from internal data sources, routes issues, and triggers downstream assistive or semi-autonomous workflows.
business_outcome: Wayfair improved product-discovery quality, created more chances to grow sales from its existing catalog, automated large volumes of supplier work, and freed internal teams from substantial manual data-entry and routing tasks.
